evidence: rl/reward.py had NEUTRAL_TRUST=0.5 hardcoded in task_reward, ignoring the dynamic trust of the chosen destination.
root_cause: Phase 4 stub was not updated when Phase 5 introduced dynamic behavioural trust; StepResult omitted dest_trust.
files_affected: environment/vanet_env.py; rl/reward.py; scripts/train_dqn.py; scripts/evaluate_dqn.py; scripts/evaluate_feddqn.py; federated/client.py
experiments_invalidated: Phase 4 and Phase 6 training reward curves (under dynamic trust conditions); historical evaluation rows preserved with caveat

evidence: DQNAgent.load in scripts/evaluate_dqn.py used default hidden architecture [64, 64] instead of config-specified hidden dims, crashing when evaluating models with non-default layer sizes (e.g. dqn_smoke).
root_cause: evaluate_dqn.py did not extract hidden dimensions from configuration and pass to DQNAgent.load.

evidence: Done flag in train_dqn.py and federated/client.py sets done=True at step_i == n_tasks - 1, which zeroed the Bellman bootstrap at artificial episode boundaries.
root_cause: Discretization of continuous task arrival stream into episodes cut off Q-value bootstrapping at task boundaries. Documented as intended episode horizon truncation.
experiments_invalidated: None (mathematical boundary documented in technical audit)

evidence: In reports/gap_matrix.md and papers.csv, G1-G6 claimed absence of work combining trust and federated RL without citing recent 2024-2025 advances (e.g., WWW 2025 Fang et al. on provably robust FRL; Jiang et al. 2025; Zero-Knowledge / trust-aware FRL).
root_cause: Phase 1 literature review was conducted with 40-paper corpus and did not reflect 2024-2026 Byzantine-robust and trust-aware FRL publications.

evidence: Phase 4 checkpoint in dqn_default was trained on only 25 episodes of 50 tasks with eps_decay_episodes=20, resulting in high policy collapse to local execution (offload_fraction 0.02 - 0.18).
root_cause: Training budget was set for student laptop smoke execution rather than convergence; Q-network barely explored offloading to edges.
experiments_invalidated: DQN and FedDQN performance claims cannot claim convergence or superiority

evidence: Energy equation in environment/vanet_env.py uses local CPU frequency for execution energy even when offloaded to an edge node if edge frequency is not substituted, or vice versa. Verified: env line 264 uses node.cpu_freq_hz.
root_cause: Vehicle execution energy vs Edge execution energy: edge nodes are mains-powered in vehicular models, yet edge compute energy was charged to the task energy metric.
